# capture device

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:captureDevice`](gmeow-captureDevice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/captureDevice>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The physical device (camera, scanner, screen-capture hardware) that captured the media. Non-functional: multiple devices may be asserted (e.g. a composite image).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) -> [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:captureDevice`](gmeow-captureDevice.md) from [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) to [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md), [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a media object to the physical device that captured it — a camera, scanner, or screen-capture rig; non-functional, so a composite may name several devices.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at an agent (the photographer is an authorship contribution, not the device) and avoid a bare literal — the range is a [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) at a [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) via [`gmeow:captureDevice`](gmeow-captureDevice.md); record the photographer separately through the contribution relator, and the capture moment via [`gmeow:captureTime`](gmeow-captureTime.md).

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:captureDevice`](gmeow-captureDevice.md) ex:cameraBody.
